input: Upgrade the home security camera system this month

gold.taskTitle: Upgrade Home Security Camera System This Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to upgrade their existing home security camera system within the current month.

questions.title: What cameras or system do you currently have?
questions.description: Understand the existing setup — brand, number of cameras, wired or wireless — to identify what is being upgraded from.

questions.title: Which specific areas of your home need coverage?
questions.description: Identify the locations the user wants monitored, such as front door, backyard, driveway, or interior rooms.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this upgrade?
questions.description: Establish a clear spending limit to narrow down camera models, storage options, and installation costs.

questions.title: Will you install the cameras yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Determine whether professional installation needs to be scheduled or if this is a DIY project.

questions.title: What is the main problem with your current system?
questions.description: Identify the core pain point driving the upgrade — poor video quality, no night vision, limited coverage, outdated app, etc.

questions.title: Do you prefer local storage, cloud storage, or both?
questions.description: Clarify how the user wants footage stored, as this affects which systems and subscription plans are compatible.

questions.title: Do you need cameras to work with a smart home platform?
questions.description: Find out if the new system must integrate with an existing platform such as Google Home, Amazon Alexa, or Apple HomeKit.
